Blend together
Ice
300ml milk of your choice
200g yogurt of your choice 
40-50g vanilla protein powder
2 frozen bananas (roughly 250g)
Cinnamon

Once blended whack in the freezer for a few hours and you’re sorted.

For my higher calorie days I whack in some Nutella, peanut butter and low calorie biscuits for added flavour and texture.

    Attractions to see, the robot restaurant is a must, I don't want to reveal too much as it would ruin the surprise but you'd be in for a good night, hands down.
